name: groom-trigger
description: Stimulate grooming command (DNg11) — fly should switch to groom state for ~600 ms.
rationale: DNg11 is the canonical grooming command. The sim drives a walk→groom hysteresis with a 0.4 s dwell guard. Stimulating DNg11 crosses the grooming threshold and the fly should rub its legs; useful for verifying the behavioral switch path before debugging more complex sequences.
